purpose: Shared by the PHP server and the MATLAB client (webupload, which lives in StitchIt). tests/web/check_pages.sh checks brainsaw/lib.php and config.php against this file. The client's tests read its copy in upload_core/tests/. Changing this file needs the sync steps in instructions.md (section on the shared contract).
rule: micID:the value of ID that is a direct child of the top-level SYSTEM key, in block style (SYSTEM: then indented ID:) or flow style (SYSTEM: {..., ID: v, ...}). Drop a trailing ' #...' comment, strip one pair of matching surrounding quotes ('...' or "..."), trim spaces, tabs, CR and LF, then replace each space with '_'. Not found gives ''. sampleID: the same for the ID directly under top-level 'sample', but spaces are NOT replaced. A leading UTF-8 BOM is ignored. The micID is then checked against ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$ by the client (no upload) and the server (400); the sampleID only has to be non-empty. Neither check is part of these vectors.
